events: {"type":"say","html":"In the dark, your hands find something smooth and cold on a table: a skull. Something hard is wedged between its teeth. You work it free: a flint."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"A human skull, set on the table to remind whoever waits here that every life ends."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"A stub of candle in an iron holder. The flint might light it."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"You hold the flint. Click on something to use it there."}
{"type":"say","html":"You strike the flint against the iron holder. Sparks catch the wick, and as the flame rises, a word rises with it, as if the light itself had spoken: LUM."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"The candle burns steadily. It is the only light in the room."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"An hourglass. All the sand has run through. Your time of waiting is over."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"A crust of bread and a bowl of water. The fare of one who has come to reflect."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"Letters cut into the wall: V.I.T.R.I.O.L. Below, smaller: Visit the interior of the earth, and by rectifying you will find the hidden stone."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"Carved above the bricked door: NONE RETURN THE WAY THEY CAME."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"The door you were led through. It was bricked shut while you were still blindfolded. The mortar is still damp."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"A heavy wooden door, locked. Light leaks in beneath it, from somewhere beyond."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"One floor stone is cut differently from the rest, with a square carved into its face. It sits a finger's width proud of the floor. Far too heavy to lift by hand."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"A rusted iron bar leans in the corner, one end hammered flat. You take it."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"You hold the iron bar. Click on something to use it there."}

{"type":"say","html":"You wedge the flat end of the bar under the stone and heave. It grinds aside, and its weight settles into you as a word, heavy and certain: KEL. In the hollow beneath, something glints."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"The stone lies to one side. Something glints in the hollow beneath."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"An iron key, cold and heavy, lies in the hollow. You take it."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"The stone lies to one side. The hollow beneath it is empty now."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"You hold the iron key. Click on something to use it there."}
{"type":"say","html":"The key turns with a heavy clunk. As the door swings open and light spills in, a word comes to you: PA."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"You step into a long hall. A lectern stands before a great double door. Something veiled waits to the east, and a bell hangs high on the west wall."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"A great double door, marked with the square and compass. It is bolted from the other side. Someone beyond must open it."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"A bell hangs high on the wall. Its rope has been cut off far out of reach."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"A heavy book lies on the lectern under a thick layer of dust. You draw a breath and blow. The dust lifts away in a cloud, and as your breath leaves you, it carries a word: HAL."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"The book reads: \"Each root names a thing. Each action shapes it. Speak them together and the thing will answer. Light, stone and breath are the Apprentice's roots; to open, to reveal and to bind, his actions.\""}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"You draw the black veil away. Beneath stands a carved Apprentice, eyes open, holding a coil of cord in both hands. As what was hidden is laid bare, a word comes to you: SE."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"You lift the coil of cord from the statue's hands. A cable-tow: the cord an Apprentice is led by."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
events: {"type":"say","html":"A carved Apprentice, eyes open. His hands are empty now."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
Tied the cord to the bell.
events: {"type":"say","html":"You hold the cable-tow. Click on something to use it there."}
{"type":"say","html":"You climb onto the bench and knot the cable-tow to the cut end of the bell-rope. As the knot pulls tight, a word binds itself to you: TU."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
Tied the cord to the bell.
events: {"type":"say","html":"You pull the cord. The bell sounds once, twice, three times. Beyond the great door, bolts draw back, one after another."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

events: {"type":"say","html":"A tracing board hangs above the altar. Whatever was written on it has faded almost to nothing."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

log: Took the flint from the skull.

log: Took the flint from the skull.

events: {"type":"say","html":"Two candles. Their light barely reaches past the altar."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

log: Took the flint from the skull.

events: {"type":"say","html":"The second pillar, its globe carved with faint lines like a map of the heavens."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
Tied the cord to the bell.
events: {"type":"say","html":"A great stone door. Every seam between its stones runs toward the carved mouth at its center."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
Tied the cord to the bell.
events: {"type":"say","html":"A carved mouth, lips parted, inside a ring of glowing sigils. It looks as if it is waiting to be spoken into."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
Tied the cord to the bell.
events: {"type":"say","html":"An iron sconce beside the alcove, made to hold a light. There is no candle in it, and no oil."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

events: {"type":"say","html":"The alcove is too dark to see into."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

events: {"type":"say","html":"A carved spiral. The air around it seems to stir, as if something was once said here."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

log: Took the flint from the skull.

events: {"type":"say","html":"Light burns in the sconce, bound there by your word."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

events: {"type":"say","html":"A shallow alcove. A spiral is carved into its back wall."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
Tied the cord to the bell.
events: {"type":"say","html":"LUM-TU — The light is already bound here. It burns steadily."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

events: {"type":"say","html":"HAL-SE — Pale breath curls from the spiral, and a voice that is not yours whispers: \"Let the stone hear the one who came before.\" The words hang in the air, fading."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

events: {"type":"say","html":"The words still hang around the spiral, fading slowly."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

log: Took the flint from the skull.

events: {"type":"say","html":"The spiral is still now. Whatever lingered here, you have taken with you."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

log: Took the flint from the skull.

events: {"type":"say","html":"The ring of sigils around the mouth is broken. The stones are no longer held."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.
Tied the cord to the bell.
events: {"type":"say","html":"HAL-PA — The mouth is silent. It has already heard what it needed."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

events: {"type":"say","html":"KEL-SE — The outlines of the stones glow. Nothing holds them now."}

log: Took the flint from the skull.

{"type":"say","html":"A curtain of water falls across the arch, from a slot in the stone above into a channel below. Something lies behind it."}

{"type":"say","html":"Across the chasm, on a narrow ledge, lies something round and carved. It looks like the crown of a pillar."}

{"type":"say","html":"Across the chasm, barely visible, an iron brazier stands cold."}

{"type":"say","html":"The water hangs motionless in the arch, like a sheet of glass. Your reflection looks back at you."}

say:Carved above the bricked door: NONE RETURN THE WAY THEY CAME.
say:Something hard is wedged between the skull's teeth. You work it free: a flint.
log:Took the flint from the skull.
say:The candle burns steadily. It is the only light in the room.
say:You hold the flint. Click on something to use it there.
say:An hourglass. All the sand has run through. Your time of waiting is over.
say:A crust of bread and a bowl of water. The fare of one who has come to reflect.
say:Letters cut into the wall: V.I.T.R.I.O.L. Below, smaller: Visit the interior of the earth, and by rectifying you will find the hidden stone.
say:One floor stone is cut differently from the rest, with a square carved into its face. It sits a finger's width proud of the floor. Far too heavy to lift by hand.
say:You hold the iron bar. Click on something to use it there.
say:You wedge the flat end of the bar under the stone and heave. It grinds aside, and its weight settles into you as a word, heavy and certain: KEL. In the hollow beneath, something glints.

say:The book reads: "Each root names a thing. Each action shapes it. Speak them together and the thing will answer. Light, stone and breath are the Apprentice's roots; to open, to reveal and to bind, his actions."
say:A carved Apprentice, eyes open. He holds a coil of cord in both hands.
say:A carved Apprentice, eyes open. His hands are empty now.
say:You lift the coil of cord from the statue's hands. A cable-tow: the cord an Apprentice is led by.
say:You pull the cord. The bell sounds once, twice, three times. Beyond the great door, bolts draw back, one after another.
say:You hold the cable-tow. Click on something to use it there.
say:You climb onto the bench and knot the cable-tow to the cut end of the bell-rope. As the knot pulls tight, a word binds itself to you: TU.
log:Tied the cord to the bell.
say:The bell has done its work.
